title: A short graph walk
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a finite vertex set $V$, with positive degree. If there is a finite sequence of neighbor steps from $x$ to $t$, then there is a walk from $x$ to $t$ in the simple graph generated by the neighbor relation whose length is strictly less than $|V|$.
hypotheses_covered: There is a finite sequence of neighbor steps from $x$ to $t$
